basic_info.description: Welcome to 1339 46th Ave, a beautifully remodeled 6 Bed 2 bath gem in the heart of San Francisco’s desirable Outer Sunset neighborhood. This turnkey home seamlessly blends modern comfort with coastal charm, offering the perfect retreat just blocks from Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park. Thoughtfully updated throughout, bright and airy residence features a spacious open-concept living and dining area with contemporary finishes, refinished hardwood floors, and an abundance of natural light. The sleek kitchen is a chef’s delight, boasting quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinetry. Each bedroom offers a peaceful escape, while the updated bathrooms showcase stylish tile work and modern fixtures. Step outside onto the brand-new deck—perfect for entertaining or relaxing in the sea breeze. The expansive, low-maintenance backyard provides a rare opportunity in the city: a private outdoor haven ideal for gatherings, gardening, or enjoying quiet mornings. Additional highlights include a large garage with interior access, potential for expansion or storage, and updated systems throughout. Walkers dream! Located just steps from popular coffee shops, restaurants, schools, Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Judah St Muni lines  and Transportation. A truly a must see!
